questions.question: Why does ice float on liquid water?

Because ice is more dense than liquid water
Because ice is colder than liquid water

Incorrect. If ice were more dense, it would sink.
Incorrect. Temperature is not the reason ice floats; density is.
Incorrect. Being a solid does not explain why it floats; density does.
